package.description: Standalone parser for sysstat sar binary data files (sa files), independent of sar/sadf

en-US.description: Standalone parser for sysstat sar binary data files (sa files), independent of sar/sadf
en-US.longDescription:
reSARch parses sysstat sa binary files on its own, without sar or sadf installed. It produces
sar text and sadf (-d -p -r -j -x) compatible output, detects anomalies across a file and charts
them as SVG, and converts older file generations to the current one. Runs on Linux, macOS and
Windows.
en-US.name: reSARch
